verdict.comment: Aidan O'Brien has yet to win a Queen Mary but TRUE LOVE could put that right. It was a big run over 6f last time and she's back at 5f.

comments.america: Her winning Bath form is none too convincing heading into an assignment of this magnitude
comments.caitling: Led early but dropped out to finish stone-cold last at Windsor (6f, good; 200-1)
comments.cardiffbythesea: Oisin Murphy rides and she gave a talented colt something to think about on debut
comments.comeoneibhlin: This is a highly demanding debut assignment and she's hard to consider
comments.eskimopie: Good runs in defeat and took some passing in Listed race at Sandown, but again vulnerable
comments.eternalsolace: Clearcut Brighton winner before a running-on fifth of nine in a Listed race at York (5f)
comments.flowerhead: Recent Chepstow winner; has plenty to find on the figures, probably too much
comments.guernseylady: Speedy filly but took four goes to get off the mark and that was a winnable race
comments.harrysgirl: Needs another step forward to be competitive here but her trainer has always liked her
comments.justicetwice: Could be described as mildly progressive but four-race maidens don't win Queen Marys
comments.lennilu: Unbeaten US filly who looked hot property in winning so well at Gulfstream in early May
comments.loveolivia: Probably went off a bit hot when found wanting into a headwind at York
comments.missyechance: It was probably a moderate race in which she made all on her Redcar debut
comments.pariscarver: Promising debut at the Curragh but David Egan has elected to jump ship to Love Olivia
comments.revivalpower: Smart pedigree and overcame glaring signs of inexperience to win at Thirsk; promising
comments.secrethideaway: Perhaps had the run of things at York but still commands respect as a Listed winner
comments.shineonme: Could reverse placings with those who beat her at Lingfield but that's not strong form
comments.socialexclusion: Easy debut winner on the AW; looked all at sea around Chester next time; tries blinkers
comments.societykiss: Clocked a quick time over C&D last month and course experience has to be an asset
comments.solanarose: Highly tried on debut (run can be upgraded) and then easily made all at Ripon
comments.spicymarg: Beat only three rivals to win at Newmarket but did so comfortably and in a good time
comments.staya: 375,000gns breeze-up buy who clocked a good time in winning by 2l at Yarmouth
comments.truelove: Twice beaten but by good horses and dropping back to a stiff 5f looks beneficial
comments.viamarie: Absent since AW win in early April but an unbeaten filly representing top connections
comments.zelaina: Stable has won this twice in three years with once-raced fillies; made all at Nottingham

races.raceComment: lennilu is marginally preferred with a score of 28.2%, holding clear edges in superior course form over flowerhead. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 2/2 at ascot. Key attributes include positive comments and improving, though returning from absence and step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: French challenger ASMARANI has acquitted himself with credit at Group level and brings unmistakable pointers to a strength in stamina.

comments.alwaslstorm: He was so comprehensively out of his comfort zone in the Derby that this also looks tough
comments.asmarani: Very different ground; form respected; leaves one of the strongest impressions of stamina
comments.carmers: 2-2 when blinkered in 1m5f races on good ground, the latter a Listed race at Navan
comments.devilsadvocate: Front-running Dante fourth at York (1m2f) makes him the form pick; dam won 1m6f Group 3
comments.furthur: Finished almost alongside Pinhole in the Chester Vase, having been unsettled early on
comments.hallelujahu: Contested three handicaps this spring off marks in the high 70s, albeit winning latest
comments.pinhole: 10l fourth in Chester Vase (1m4f) but against Derby principals and still looks promising
comments.rahiebb: Another 2nd last time, suggesting he's likely get 1m6f but still needs marked improvement
comments.scandinavia: Fourth maiden when he eventually draw clear at Navan (1m2f); looked sure to stay further
comments.shackleton: Minor honours in two 1m2f Group 3s, sticking to his task on reappearance; Ryan Moore rides
comments.spinningwheel: Won novice events at 1m2f and 11.4f; not the form pick but shapes as if he's sure to stay
comments.titaniumemperor: Kept on into 4th over 1m4f, but that's the third time he's been safely held in Listed race
comments.toosoon: Below form on reappearance and he has something to prove regarding trip, ground and class

races.raceComment: hallelujahu is marginally preferred with a score of 33.0%, holding clear edges in more reliable profile over rahiebb. Won 1 of last 3 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 2 attempts. Excellent course form of 2/6 at ascot. Key attributes include positive comments and consistent performer, though returning from absence and step up in class and unfavorable draw and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Godolphin's CINDERELLA'S DREAM made it 7-10 with her easy win in a Group 2 last month and is a major player again under a penalty.

comments.cinderellasdream: Record of 1111711221 and easy winner of Group 2 latest; major player under 3lb penalty
comments.crimsonadvocate: Has done well since being reinvented as a miler and should have more to offer at this trip
comments.elmalka: Last year's 1,000 Guineas winner; drops back in trip/class and has possibilities
comments.fallenangel: Won Irish 1,000 Guineas last year; drops back into a Group 2 and she's high on the list
comments.onelook: Overall record of 4-9 and went close in Group 2 at the Curragh latest; in the mix
comments.runninglion: Won this race last year and could make a bold bid in defence of her crown; cheekpieces on

comments.startofday: Still lightly raced but she has some work to do in this company

races.raceComment: soprano is confidently preferred with a score of 66.0%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over elmalka. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 3 wins from 12 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and strong course form, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.losangeles: Plenty of good Group 1 form; battled back to deny Anmaat at the Curragh (10.5f) last time
comments.mapofstars: Powerful challenge took him to within a neck of victory in the Group 1 Ganay at Longchamp
comments.ombudsman: Lost his unbeaten record on return but it was a highly positive show in all other respects
comments.royalchampion: 4th in Sandown Group 3 (1m2f, good) was another good effort but he needs markedly better
comments.seethefire: Hammered her rivals for a 12l win in Group 2 at York (1m2f, good to firm) five weeks ago

races.raceComment: royalchampion is marginally preferred with a score of 61.6%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over seethefire. Won 3 of last 5 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 4 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 6/19 at ascot. verdict.comment: My Cloud has very strong claims, while TONY MONTANA (nap) and Greek Order are interesting runners for Michael Bell.

comments.ancientrome: Defied a 3lb higher mark at Glorious Goodwood in 2023; far from solid on 2025 form
comments.arabianlight: Progressive; ran well off top weight last time, taking record to 211313; solid contender
comments.bluebrother: Successful in France; midfield in Saudi handicap in sole start for new (Qatari) stable
comments.bopedro: Retains plenty of ability aged nine but he's on a 21-race losing sequence
comments.bulletpoint: Record of 4111 since handicapping; well on top in sole run this season; strong contender
comments.ebtsguard: Spring Cup winner; ties in with My Cloud on Newbury running last month; could go well
comments.epictetus: Group 3 winner for the Gosdens; showed some promise on stable/seasonal debut
comments.foxlegacy: Landed a notable 1m1f handicap at Newmakret on stable/seasonal debut; may improve further
comments.galeron: Ran creditably in this year's Lincoln but hasn't won since his 2yo days
comments.greekorder: Runner-up off this mark in the 2023 Cambridgeshire; one to note on debut for new yard
comments.hiroyal: Close second in the Thirsk Hunt Cup on handicap/seasonal debut but is inconsistent
comments.jeffkoons: Two wins in Qatar for current yard; judged on all form he's on a difficult mark
comments.latrinidad: Creditable third in both runs this term but has nothing in hand off current mark
comments.magnumopus: Ran creditably in the Lincoln when last seen but current mark leaves him in a tough spot
comments.mycloud: Won well over C&D in April then followed up at Newbury; very progressive; respected
comments.popmaster: Has plenty of Ascot form but is 0-7 over this trip and not the percentage call
comments.qirat: Consistent; went close in the Victoria Cup; likely player if taking well to headgear
comments.sean: Capable of very useful form but last few efforts don't augur well; 0-17 for this yard
comments.silawi: 1m2f win on British debut; 2lb well in under a penalty but drop to 1m is an unknown
comments.sisyphean: Useful form at York in last two 1m attempts; could well have more to offer at this trip
comments.soldiersempire: Consistent in Bahrain for current stable; seems to have a stiff task in this field
comments.talisevolvere: Has done most of his winning on AW; came up well short in this race last year
comments.theliffey: Record is 2-4 (1-1 over 1m); still open to further improvement; second run for new yard
comments.toimyson: Had some good form last term but needs to step up plenty on his 2025 efforts
comments.tokenomics: Four wins from last six starts; Irish trainer landed this prize with similar type in 2018
comments.tonymontana: Useful over 1m2f; showed promise behind high-class rival in sole 1m attempt; interesting
comments.urbanlion: An improving sort but turning out quickly could backfire (seems best fresh)
comments.wahdan: Handicap debutant; not particularly solid as his best efforts may not be reliable
comments.whipcracker: Ran respectably in first-time cheekpieces at Sandown most recently; this is harder
comments.whitcomberockstar: Productive last term but faces a tough assignment off this mark on reappearance

races.raceComment: mycloud is marginally preferred with a score of 57.4%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form over qirat. Won 2 of last 2 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 2 wins from 3 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 3/5 at ascot. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and strong course form and positive comments and improving, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Hard to warm to many of these and JUMEIRA VISION is taken to resume winning ways at the main expense of Gemini Man.

comments.geminiman: Exposed maiden but he's run well on Flat and over hurdles for new yard; each-way shout
comments.hotteam: Four-time C&D winner; not sparkled this year but can't discount in this field
comments.jumeiravision: On a dangerous mark and this course winner can rebound from a quiet Musselburgh run latest
comments.millbuie: 12-race maiden; needs to take a step forward for the addition of new headgear
comments.onthebubble: Flat/hurdle winner last summer but she's yet to find her best for new stable in 2025
comments.rampant: 20-race maiden but comes here on the back of a good AW run; a bit more to prove on turf
comments.zebrastar: Two fair efforts since returned to turf; conditions should be fine but others are stronger
comments.zumaaty: Course winner last September; needs to come on for last month's ninth but not impossible

races.raceComment: hotteam is marginally preferred with a score of 53.6%. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Baggot Street has more to offer but Aspiral and AWAAFI are newcomers of note.

comments.alasrae: £60,000 breeze-up 2yo; appeal on paper and yard 3-6 with 2yos here; check betting
comments.aspiral: 4,000gns foal; dam a fair 1m/1m2f winner; yard rich in 2yo talent; betting revealing
comments.awaafi: Half-sister to smart sprinter Kylian (RPR 109); dam a Listed winner; a newcomer of note
comments.baggotstreet: Promise in both Ripon starts (5f and 6f, good ground); should make a bold bid
comments.campenaerts: Dropped away to finish 6th on last month's Brighton debut (6f, good); improvement a must
comments.havinaflyer: 10,000gns breeze-up 2yo; dam a modest maiden; yard not renowned for 2yo success
comments.veiledtruth: 20,000gns half-brother to two winners; yard has modest 2yo strike-rate; best watched

races.raceComment: baggotstreet is marginally preferred with a score of 21.6%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and more progressive over campenaerts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 2 attempts. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
